remarks: Charming Colonial home offering the perfect blend of comfort, character and convenience. This well-maintained house features spacious living areas filled with natural light and an inviting layout ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Two bedrooms upstairs along with a third room perfect for a den or office. A spacious backyard provides plenty of space for outdoor gatherings. Detached garage and off-street parking. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, schools, parks, and major commuter routes, this home offers both tranquility and accessibility. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy classic charm in a prime location.
